content: Apple distinguishes consumed, rendered, and played-back audio completion. dataPlayedBack covers downstream processing/device latency but marks buffer completion, not beep onset. Nil-time scheduleBuffer follows previous scheduled buffers; AVAudioSession.outputLatency reports output latency. Project inference: use pipeline timestamps and record physical beep onset for end-to-end acceptance; callback counts alone cannot establish audible latency. Sources: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfaudio/avaudioplayernode https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfaudio/avaudioplayernodecompletioncallbacktype/dataplayedback https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfaudio/avaudiosession/outputlatency
